task_summary: Implement an Adaptive Cruise Control simulation with PID controllers, mode selection logic, and 150s vehicle simulation producing results CSV and report.
decomposition_rationale: The task has three clear functional domains: (1) the reusable PID controller component, (2) the ACC system with mode selection logic, and (3) the simulation runner with data I/O, tuning, and reporting. Separating these matches the task's explicit file structure (pid_controller.py, acc_system.py, simulation.py) and ensures each skill has a non-overlapping responsibility.

skills.name: evo-control-pid-controller
skills.description: Implements a discrete PID controller class with anti-windup (conditional integration/clamping) and proper first-timestep handling. This is the foundational control building block used by the ACC system.
skills.responsibility: Provide a standalone PIDController class with reset() and compute(error, dt) methods, including output limits and integral windup prevention via clamping.
dr_sections: 1. Discrete PID Controller Implementation in Python
1.1 Mathematical Formulation and the Derivative Term

skills.name: evo-acc-system-logic
skills.description: Implements the AdaptiveCruiseControl class with mode selection (cruise/follow/emergency), TTC calculation, desired distance computation, and minimum acceleration blending strategy. Reads config from vehicle_params.yaml structure.
skills.responsibility: Provide ACC mode selection logic, TTC safety checks, desired distance calculation (time headway policy), and acceleration command selection using minimum acceleration strategy across dual PID controllers.
dr_sections: 3. PID Tuning for ACC: Practical Parameter Ranges and Methodology

skills.name: evo-acc-simulation-runner
skills.description: Implements the simulation loop, data I/O pipeline, PID tuning results generation, and report writing. Reads sensor_data.csv and vehicle_params.yaml, loads PID gains from tuning_results.yaml, runs 150s closed-loop simulation with Euler integration, and outputs simulation_results.csv and acc_report.md.
skills.responsibility: Handle all file I/O (YAML config loading/writing, CSV reading/writing), the 1501-step simulation loop with proper physics integration, tuning_results.yaml creation with recommended PID gains, simulation_results.csv output with correct NaN handling, and acc_report.md generation.
dr_sections: 5. Reading YAML and CSV with PyYAML and Pandas
5.3 Writing Results to CSV (Handling NaNs properly)
